## About {height=400px}

::: {.card .spacer width="25%"}
:::

::: {.card title="About this study" width="50%"}

Do managers describe women and men differently? I used natural language processing to analyse their feedback on employee development. I did this in a research partnership with [Culture Amp](https://www.cultureamp.com/){target="_blank"}, a company that provides employee feedback and engagement software.

**Methods:** natural language processing (NLP), large language models (LLMs), transformer models, embeddings, sentiment analysis, text classification, text clustering, text analytics, model evaluation, data cleaning, statistical modelling (mixed-effects and longitudinal models)

**Tools:** Python, Hugging Face Transformers (BERT, RoBERTa, GoEmotions), Sentence Transformers, spaCy, NLTK, Gemini, Jupyter, AWS, Saturn Cloud

**Credits:** PhD research at the [University of Melbourne](https://www.unimelb.edu.au/){target="_blank"}, in a research partnership with [Culture Amp](https://www.cultureamp.com/){target="_blank"}. Co-supervised by the University of Melbourne ([Computing and Information Systems](https://cis.unimelb.edu.au/){target="_blank"}) and [UC Berkeley Haas](https://haas.berkeley.edu/){target="_blank"}.

:::
